A '''nuna salad sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] made with the [[Foodstuff/Legends|ingrediant]] [[nuna salad]]. They were served on [[Primeday/Legends|Primedays]] along side a cup of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] as part of the lunch and dinner [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate specials]] at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 6.1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nuna salad sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
